title: vNext View Hints Vocabulary
description: Presentation hints a client reads when it draws a schema as a form or a record view. A MIXIN: both the record vocabulary (master schemas) and the input vocabulary (transition and function-input schemas) accept every keyword here. The runtime reads none of them.

x-helpText.description: Help text shown under or beside the field.

x-placeholder.description: Placeholder shown in an empty input.

x-uiHint.description: A rendering hint for the field (e.g. 'hidden', 'readonly'). Clients ignore hints they do not know.

x-uiNote.description: Free-form note for whoever renders or maintains the field. Never displayed.

x-group.description: The group (section) a generated form places the field in.

keywords.description: The view-hint keywords, for composition by the role vocabularies.
